name: xoga750-fix4-traderwise-ogp-dev
description: DEV ONLY. Adds the two rows legacy MySQL holds in web_xtr_handle_portfolio_traderwise_table (ogp/asinghal, ogp/FVaipel, seen 26 Nov) to the OGA table, which is empty. Without them an OGP Web XTR run does not apply the TextTT rule for those two traders (.m:504-520 / resolve-xtr-portfolio.js). No CFS row exists in legacy, so the CFS extra rows of XOGA-750 are NOT affected by this. Two rows inserted, nothing else touched.

source.sql: SELECT CAST(md5('xoga750-traderwise-' || v.bu || '-' || v.trader) AS uuid) AS uuid, '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AS tenant_id, v.bu AS bu_name, v.trader AS trade_name FROM (VALUES ('ogp','asinghal'),('ogp','FVaipel')) AS v(bu, trader)
